title: STARTEX — Recall Team Paged, 06:00 Tuesday

fields.location: Pinecrest Fresh Cut, LLC — Plant 1, Salinas, California, with the Stockton, Phoenix and Dallas DCs
fields.load: Mid-harvest: about 187,000 cases a week through Stockton, Phoenix, Dallas and direct to Rivermark Kits in Fresno
fields.staffing: Shift A starting on lines L1 to L4; DC day crews reporting; Recall Team seats on call
fields.narration: STARTEX. This is an exercise. It is 06:00 Pacific Time on Tuesday, October 12, 2027, mid-harvest in the Salinas Valley, and Plant 1 is starting shift A on lines L1 to L4 with romaine, spring mix and baby spinach from Salinas Valley growers. MES, ERP and all three DC warehouse systems show normal status, coolers are reading 34 to 38°F, and there are no open holds. Dr. Imani Brooks, Recall Coordinator, has just paged the Recall Team to the bridge at (831) 555-0131, code 2200. Join the bridge now in your seat.

status.note: Receiving normally; weekly EDI file, records partly on paper

fields.facilitatorNote: Do not tell players why Dr. Brooks paged the team; the reason comes in the next inject. Make sure each seat has the Recall Team roster and bridge details before reading.
